text: गंगा और उमा सगी बहनें थीं।
hook_to_payoff: Main loop (how were the Ganga and Uma sisters, and how did one of them become the river of three paths?) answers in scenes 3–4 (Himavan and Mena's two daughters, the Ganga the elder), turns at the verse card (scene 6, Himavan gives the Ganga away for the good of the three worlds), pays off the river's half at scene 7 (the gods carry her to heaven) and closes at scene 10, when the sage names both daughters, the Ganga and Uma Devi, at about 88–91% of runtime.
